info.title: Personalized disbursement material task service
info.description: 2026-10-29: Accept the original business JSON directly. Download replyImageUrl before accepting a task. Download failure does not create or replace tasks; subsequent processing and results are unchanged. 2026-10-30: Personalized tasks resolve non-exact product names to unique existing checklist candidates using the generation model. Original approval product names and facts are preserved; checklistFileName identifies the selected Word file.

servers.description: Replace with deployment address; local verification is not deployment acceptance.

post.summary: Download approval PDF from JSON and create or replace a task.
post.description: Direct application/json body. Require bsnEvtId,userNo,taskId,replyImageUrl. GET one PDF from HTTP(S), including intranet hosts; max 10 MiB. Download and validate before saving/enqueueing. Failed submissions never modify old tasks. Redirect limit 5, per-operation network timeout 30 seconds, total download deadline 60 seconds; no automatic download retries.

200.description: Task persisted and enqueued; generation not yet completed.

400.description: Invalid content type or JSON syntax. No task mutation.

422.description: Missing/invalid identifiers or replyImageUrl, invalid business fields, or empty PDF. No task mutation.

503.description: Storage or service unavailable. Creation not acknowledged.

502.description: PDF download HTTP/network failure or too many redirects. No task mutation.

504.description: PDF download timeout. No task mutation.

post.summary: Query a task state or its saved result.
post.description: Lookup uses bsnEvtId+taskId, not userNo. An existing record echoes its saved creation userNo. No generation or current-rule refresh on query. All task states and not-found use HTTP 200. Restart marks unfinished tasks FAILED; no automatic rerun.

200.description: Mutually exclusive saved state/result or task-not-created reply.

userNo.description: Required, trimmed identifier; stored creation userNo is echoed for an existing task.

aspdNm.description: Contract saleable product name; may describe a parent product pool.

lwrsInd.description: Low risk code; do not assume the meaning of internal codes.

replyImageUrl.description: Approval PDF URL. Required and downloaded for task creation; optional in historical business data.

ccy.description: Currency code as supplied by the upstream system.

ctrTamt.description: Disbursement amount as a decimal string, or empty if unknown.

payOutAspdNm.description: Optional drawdown product context; PDF explicit facts take priority. Never used as fallback when the PDF contains no identifiable saleable product.

subcontracts.description: Optional original subcontract details; null ignored. PDF explicit facts take priority.

BusinessData.description: Reusable business data. Creation uses CreateTaskRequest, which requires replyImageUrl. Optional null fields are ignored and additional business fields retained.

idCardNo.description: Identity card number; sensitive, must not be echoed in error logs.

x-model-api-configuration.scope: server-side deployment configuration; not caller request fields
x-model-api-configuration.implementationStatus: implemented; offline HTTP transport verified; real model acceptance pending T28
x-model-api-configuration.deployment: Inject process environment variables or use Docker --env-file. Do not embed actual keys in code, archives, prompts, logs, responses or business requests.

x-contract-invariants: One effective local worker; provider inference may continue after local cancellation.
Only the current internal generationId in PROCESSING may publish a result.
Replacement cancels same-business unfinished tasks and enqueues at tail.
Restart fails all persisted PENDING/PROCESSING tasks without rerun.
PDF explicit facts take priority; JSON fills facts absent from PDF, never supplies a missing product.
All saleable products must match exact checklist files and complete processing.
Only explicitly applicable materials are retained; uncertain applicability is excluded. grtstlRcmbNm filters mismatched first-level directories; headings without stage terms remain eligible.
No merging across subjects or products; names carry a product prefix; items are grouped by product and original Word directories.
total equals recursive material leaf count; item IDs unique and product references valid.
No partial successful output; zero final materials is FAILED.
Missing display system/date/department use specified defaults; other missing display strings are empty.
